actors.name: Kettlewell Parish Clerk
actors.private_context: The clerk posted notices about the open meeting regarding the bus-route cut. They are aware that the last such meeting drew 22 attendees and hope for a good turnout.

actors.name: Kettlewell villagers (as a cohort)
actors.private_context: Villagers have seen the notices about the meeting. Some may be concerned about the bus-route cut, but attendance is voluntary and depends on individual interest and availability.

shared_context: An open meeting about the bus-route cut is scheduled to take place in Kettlewell. The parish clerk has posted notices around the village. The meeting is open to all villagers. The last similar meeting had 22 attendees.

starting_events.description: The parish clerk has posted notices about the open meeting.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 30 distinct villagers attended the meeting before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
